# Secrets

<!--
Encoded with straddling checkerboard + columnar transposition,
base64-wrapped. Cipher in decode.js, keyphrase in reveal.js.

To add an entry:
    node reveal.js --encode "YOUR SECRET HERE"
Then paste the output under a new `## tag` heading below.

To read an entry:
    node reveal.js <tag>

Limitations: A–Z and spaces only. Digits, punctuation, and casing are
dropped on encode.

Reference entries from IDENTITY.md by tag, e.g.
    {{hometown}}    {{debt}}    {{codename}}
-->
